name: Hollow Petals
source: Ren Asuka, a brilliant but haunted Lead Inspector from Tokyo, is drawn into a remote mountain village hiding a 50-year-old bloody secret. When a gruesome murder shocks Kazahana Village, Ren must uncover the truth behind the "Sacrifice of the Silent Flowers" before the valley claims its next victim. A dark, psychological mystery visual novel with multiple endings.
translation: 来自东京、才华出众却心怀阴霾的主任警部飞鸟莲，被卷入了一座隐藏着50年前血腥秘密的偏僻山村。当一桩惨绝人寰的命案震惊风花村时，莲必须在山谷夺走下一名受害者的性命之前，揭开“无声之花献祭”背后的真相。这是一部拥有多重结局的暗黑心理悬疑视觉小说。
